note: Bavli: [Gittin 56b:18](sefaria:Gittin.56b.18) (2 segments). Gazetteer: “Onkelos bar Kalonikos, the son of Titus’s sister”. Father of the convert Onkelos (אונקלוס is in the list). Spelled קלונימוס in Avodah Zarah 11a:2. Greek Kalonymos 'good name' / Kallinikos 'fair victory' - standard. He is a Roman gentile, but the name later becomes a common Jewish name.
Bavli: [Nazir 16a:6](sefaria:Nazir.16a.6) (6 segments). Gazetteer: “Rabbi Pappeyas”. Tanna (with R. Yehoshua, Eduyot 7). Greek Pappias, cf. פפוס in the list - standard.
Bavli: [Gittin 56a:4](sefaria:Gittin.56a.4) (3 segments). Gazetteer: “Rabbi Zekharya ben Avkolas”. Father's name. Greek Eukolos 'easy-going' - commonly given. Fits Fathers' names too.
